name: Sora Kakeru Businessman
original_name: 宇宙翔けるビジネスマン
source:
Hero is a businessman in space trading company. He was able to get mining rights for resources in Norma planet. But ruling family was overthrown by the Queen of Darkness and his rights are in danger now. He undergoes a quest to rescue princess. For corporate justice!

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家宇宙贸易公司的商务人士，好不容易取得了诺玛行星的资源开采权。然而，统治当地的王族遭到黑暗女王推翻，他的权益如今也危在旦夕。为了拯救公主，他踏上冒险之旅。为企业的正义而战！

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
